env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local

# A concrete option field of an unexported generic type keeps its option
# through an exported use: the importer sees X.N as int?, not int.
cd good
logos run .
stdout '^nil-check ok$'

-- good/go.mod --
module example.com/optconcrete

go 1.27
-- good/lib/lib.lgo --
package lib

type box[T any] struct {
	V T
	N int?
}

var X box[int] = box[int]{V: 1, N: 2}
-- good/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/optconcrete/lib"
)

func main() {
	if lib.X.N == nil {
		fmt.Println("nil-check unexpected")
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("nil-check ok")
}
